title: Harnessing de-oiled Glycine max seed-anchored-CuO nanoparticles for adsorptive removal of crystal violet dye with comprehensive mechanistic insights
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,24406-24423
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02568K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Mahnoor Usman, Fozia Batool, Tunzeel Iqbal, Sobia Noreen, Humaira Yasmeen Gondal, Taleeha Roheen, Rahman Qadir, Muhammad Amin, Sayyam Sajid, Allah Ditta
A novel solution is introduced by harnessing the power of de-oiled Glycine max L. seeds (DO/S) and enhancing them with copper oxide-loaded nanoparticles (DO/S NPs) to effectively eradicate the toxic crystal violet dye from aqueous solutions.
